The top sign features blue neon-style lettering that appears to read 'CALLE' or similar, with a glowing border. The bottom sign is split into two sections: the left side has complex blue neon geometric patterns and fragmented text, while the right side features a white glowing panel with a stylized, possibly animal-like or abstract figure. The signs exhibit a futuristic, cyberpunk aesthetic rather than standard municipal design. There is visible glow bleed and some structural ambiguity in the mounting hardware.
